title: The Pink Angel Halloween Costume
intro: Angelic, technically. A hot pink ruffle dress, pink feather wings and a fluffy halo, finished with white platforms and a rose clutch. It photographs like a dream and you can sit down in it, which is more than most costumes can say.

images.alt: That girl collage on blush pink of a hot pink ruffle dress, pink feather angel wings, a white feather halo, white platform heels, a pink rose clutch and silver star earrings.
Mirror selfie in a farmhouse hallway of a woman in a hot pink ruffle dress, pink feather angel wings and a white halo, holding a pink tumbler and a pink rose clutch.

items.name: Hot pink ruffle chiffon mini dress with long sleeves
Pink satin rose clutch with pearl handle
Silver rhinestone double star drop earrings
